harness.title: Zip slip: extract crafted archives and look for files written outside dest/
harness.built_by: R1 (Claude Code session), converted from the review kit's example harness

attacks.what: two levels up, into a new folder
sibling folder sharing the dest prefix
traversal hidden behind the assets/minecraft/ prefix that extractMinecraft looks for

harness.success_criterion: An attack counts as exploited when its marker file exists anywhere outside that run's dest/ folder. Each attack runs in a fresh folder; extractZip and extractMinecraft (where present) are both tested.

isolation: docker, --network none, read-only root, 1 GB, 2 CPUs, 120 s per sample
